messages:
sara-partnerships: Urgent — AWS Marketplace portal is rejecting partner POs for the AcmeHardware bundle. Error from portal: SKU_NOT_FOUND on composite SKU.

mike-salesops: Ugh. Can you paste the portal error payload and an example PO XML so we can triage quickly?

sara-partnerships: Here's the clipped error and PO snippet we got from customer:

```
<PurchaseOrder>
  <Item>
    <SKU>AH-BUNDLE-2024-US</SKU>
    <Quantity>1</Quantity>
  </Item>
</PurchaseOrder>

Portal error: {"code":"SKU_NOT_FOUND","details":"SKU 'AH-BUNDLE-2024-US' not in vendor catalog"}
```

ellie-ops: Looks like vendor changed SKU taxonomy in their recent feed push — maybe hyphen vs underscore or channel suffix. Marketplace portal does strict matching.

vendor-bob: We shipped a SKU normalization last week to remove hyphens for our internal catalog. Our canonical SKU is `AHBUNDLE2024` now. We did warn partners but maybe the marketplace feed adapter didn't pick it up.

devon-engineering: Manual mapping in the portal is the fastest way to unblock the PO, but FYI downstream billing and reserved capacity reconciliation expects the original SKU format. We'll need a reconciliation transform if we alias.

procure-annie: Customer renewal is due EOD Friday. If this blocks the PO we risk a delay. Manual mapping + invoice note acceptable if we get sign-off.

ace-legal: Flag: contract SOW references the original SKU string. If we start accepting the new canonical SKU we should log an amendment or at least an internal change record. Small redline to SOW may be needed if this persists.

mike-salesops: Proposal: temporary alias mapping in marketplace portal to accept `AH-BUNDLE-2024-US` => `AHBUNDLE2024` for the next 7 days. Vendor to publish a corrected marketplace feed (with both legacy and canonical tags) by tomorrow morning. Engineering to add reconciliation script to map legacy SKUs to canonical in billing for 2 weeks.

vendor-bob: We can publish the feed with both `legacy_skus` tag by 10:00 PT tomorrow. Ill open a vendor support ticket with AWS too.

ellie-ops: I'll create the temporary alias in the portal now and document it. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MP-4522 (ops owner: @ellie-ops)

devon-engineering: I'll slot a 4-hr task to add the reconciliation transform and a unit test. ETA: 48 hrs. PR will reference MP-4522.

ace-legal: I'll prepare a short amendment note and route for e-sign if we end up keeping canonical SKUs. ETA: 24 hrs.

procure-annie: Can we confirm whether finance needs any manual approvals for the invoice that will reference the mapped SKU? I can hold payment until we get legal sign-off if needed.

mike-salesops: Finance OK with short hold as long as ops adds comment to PO and we capture vendor confirmation. I'll coordinate with @procure-annie and @vendor-bob.

marketplace-bot: Deploy job marketplace-feed-sync failed at 2024-05-30T03:12:10Z — showing discrepancy in SKU normalization layer. See logs: /var/log/mfeed/normalize-20240530.log

sara-partnerships: Great. Owners/next steps summarized:
- Ops (ellie-ops): add temporary alias mapping now (done/notify)
- Vendor (vendor-bob): publish dual-tag feed by 10:00 PT tomorrow
- Eng (devon-engineering): reconciliation transform + tests, ETA 48 hrs
- Legal (ace-legal): amendment note, ETA 24 hrs
- SalesOps (mike-salesops): coordinate finance & customer comms
- Procure (procure-annie): hold payment as needed and confirm once alias in place

Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when they acknowledge.

vendor-bob: :thumbsup: will post feed update when live.

ellie-ops: :thumbsup: alias created, added comment to PO, MP-4522 updated.

devon-engineering: :thumbsup: picked up.

ace-legal: :thumbsup: on watch.

procure-annie: :thumbsup: will wait for vendor confirmation before releasing.

mike-salesops: I'll send a short note to customer: "We have a temporary mapping in place; final SKU normalization will be completed by vendor and reconciled internally." Sending now.

sara-partnerships: Closing loop — monitoring until reconciliation PR is merged. If anything slips, escalate to partnerships-ops. Thanks everyone.
